start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles zyada pasand hain ya squares?

turns.reply: Kabir, sochiye vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing lagani hai—fence ki total lambai perimeter hogi. Aap kaise nikaalenge?
Kabir, perimeter ke liye shape ki har side ki length jodiye. Rectangle mein length aur breadth ki chaar sides jodkar total batayiye—kaise?
